# 0. General settings

```{r library,warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

Sys.time()
```

```{r}
carbon_source<-paste(getwd(),"Carbon_Info","Carbon_name_for_rawod.csv",sep="/") %>%
  read_csv()
```

# ECOR
## plate layout
```{r}
ecor_plate_layout<-paste(getwd(),"raw_data","experiment_info.xlsx",sep="/") %>%
  read_xlsx(sheet = "ECOR_experiment_plate",range = "A1:D385") %>%
  mutate(Well=paste(Row,Col,sep="")) %>%
  mutate(Strain = stringr::str_replace(Strain, "^ECOR([1-9])$", "ECOR0\\1")) %>%
  mutate(Fill = ifelse(grepl(x = Strain, pattern = "^ECOR"), "1", "0") %>% as.factor()) %>%
  mutate(Col=factor(Col,levels = seq(1,24))) %>%
  mutate(Row=factor(Row,levels = rev(LETTERS[1:16])))

blank_wells<-ecor_plate_layout[ecor_plate_layout$Strain=="blank",]$Well
strain_wells<-ecor_plate_layout[grepl(pattern = "^ECOR",x = ecor_plate_layout$Strain),]$Well

textcol <- "grey40"
p <- ggplot(ecor_plate_layout, aes(x=Col, y=Row, fill=Fill)) +
  geom_tile(colour="white", size=0.2) +
  guides(fill="none") +
  labs(x="", y="", title="Transfer") +
  scale_y_discrete(expand=c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand=c(0, 0), breaks=seq(1,24), position = "top") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "grey90", "1" = "#d53e4f")) +
  geom_text(aes(label=Strain), size=3) +
  theme_classic(base_size=10) +
  theme(
    legend.position="right", 
    axis.text.x=element_text(size=10),
    axis.text.y=element_text(size=10),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, linewidth = 1.5),
    plot.title=element_text(hjust=0, size=14, face="bold"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1.2),
    aspect.ratio=85.48/127.76
  )

print(p)
```
## experiment date
```{r}
ecor_exp_date<-paste(getwd(),"raw_data","experiment_info.xlsx",sep="/") %>%
  read_xlsx(sheet = "ECOR_experiment_data",range = "A1:D36") %>%
  rename(Carbon=`carbon source`) %>%
  left_join(carbon_source,by="Carbon") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Abb))

```
## extract blank data
```{r}

extract_od <- function(fn_cb, fn_dir) {
  csv_full_paths <- list.files(path = fn_dir, 
                               pattern = "\\.csv$", 
                               full.names = TRUE, 
                               recursive = FALSE)

  all_csv_data <- map_df(csv_full_paths, ~{
    base_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(.x))
    
    read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      rename(Row = 1) %>%

      pivot_longer(cols = -Row, 
                   names_to = "Col", 
                   values_to = "OD") %>%

      mutate(Col = as.numeric(Col),
             Row = factor(Row, levels = LETTERS[1:16]),
             time = as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(base_name, "\\d+")),
             Abb = fn_cb)
  })
  
  return(all_csv_data)
}

all_ecor_df<-NULL
for(i in 1:nrow(ecor_exp_date)){
  my_dir<-paste(getwd(),"raw_data","ECOR","main_data",ecor_exp_date$subfolder[i],sep="/")
  my_cb<-ecor_exp_date$Abb[i]
  df_each_cb<-extract_od(my_cb, my_dir)
  all_ecor_df<-bind_rows(all_ecor_df,df_each_cb)
}
all_ecor_df<-all_ecor_df %>% mutate(Well=paste(Row,Col,sep=""))
blank_ecor_df<-all_ecor_df %>% filter(Well %in% blank_wells) %>% filter(Row %in% c("O","P") & Col %in% c(21,22))

my_tmp<-data.frame(Well=c("O21","O22","P21","P22"),
                   rep=paste("rep",seq(1,4),sep=""))
blank_ecor_df<-blank_ecor_df %>% left_join(my_tmp,by="Well")
  

Sys.time()
```
## visualization all
```{r,fig.height=10,fig.width=12,dpi=300}
rep_colors <- c("rep1"="#4F6D8A","rep2"="#6B8F71","rep3"="#B07D62","rep4"="#7B6D8D")
plot_df<-blank_ecor_df %>%
  filter(time %nin% c(1,2,3))
g<-ggscatter(plot_df,x="time",y="OD",
             xlab="Time (hours)",ylab="OD (Absorbance)",
             color="rep",legend="right",size=0.5, alpha=0.5)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.1,color="red",linetype=2)+
  scale_color_manual(values = rep_colors, name = "Replicate") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = get_breaks(from = 0,to = 80,by = 40))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = get_breaks(from = 0,to=0.8,by=0.4),limits = c(0,1))+
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) 
facet(g,facet.by = "Abb")

Sys.time()
```

```{r, fig.height=3.5,fig.width=2.5, dpi=300}
g<-ggscatter(plot_df,x="time",y="OD",

facet(g,facet.by = "Abb",nrow = 3)
```

## control data
```{r}
allctrl_ecor_df<-NULL
for(i in 1:nrow(carbon_source)){
  my_dir<-paste(getwd(),"raw_data","ECOR","control_data",carbon_source$ECOR_controllfolder[i],sep="/")
  my_cb<-carbon_source$Abb[i]
  df_each_cb<-extract_od(my_cb, my_dir)
  allctrl_ecor_df<-bind_rows(allctrl_ecor_df,df_each_cb)
}
allctrl_ecor_df<-allctrl_ecor_df %>% mutate(Well=paste(Row,Col,sep=""))
ctrl_ecor_df<-allctrl_ecor_df %>% filter(Well %in% strain_wells)
my_tmp<-ecor_plate_layout %>% filter(grepl(pattern = "^ECOR",x = Strain)) %>%
  select(Well,Reps,Strain) %>%
  rename(rep=Reps, strain=Strain) %>%
  mutate(rep=paste("rep",rep,sep=""))
ctrl_ecor_df<-ctrl_ecor_df %>% left_join(my_tmp,by="Well")
Sys.time()
```

## visualization
```{r,fig.height=4,fig.width=16,dpi=300}
my_reps<-c("Glc","Succ","Lac")
my_list<-list()
for(i in 1:length(my_reps)){
  my_cb<-my_reps[i]
  plot_df<-ctrl_ecor_df %>% 
    filter(Abb==my_cb) %>% 
    filter(time %nin% c(1,2,3))
  g<-ggscatter(plot_df,x="time",y="OD",
             xlab="Time (hours)",ylab="OD (Absorbance)",title = my_cb,
             color="rep",size=0.5, alpha=0.5)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.1,color="red",linetype=2)+
  scale_color_manual(values = rep_colors, name = "Replicate") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = get_breaks(from = 0,to = 80,by = 40))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = get_breaks(from = 0,to=0.8,by=0.4),limits = c(0,1))+
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) 
  g<-facet(g,facet.by = "strain",nrow = 3)
  my_list[[i]]<-g
}

my_list[[1]]
my_list[[2]]
my_list[[3]]

Sys.time()
```

# MA
## plate layout
```{r}
ma_plate_layout<-paste(getwd(),"raw_data","experiment_info.xlsx",sep="/") %>%
  read_xlsx(sheet = "MA_experiment_plate",range = "A1:F385") %>%
  mutate(Well=paste(Row,Col,sep="")) %>%
  rename(rep=Reps,colony=Strain,round=Rounds,lineage=Lineage) %>%
  mutate(colony_round=paste(colony,round,sep="@"))%>%
  mutate(Fill = ifelse(grepl(x = colony, pattern = "^colony"), "1", "0") %>% as.factor()) %>%
  mutate(Col=factor(Col,levels = seq(1,24))) %>%
  mutate(Row=factor(Row,levels = rev(LETTERS[1:16]))) %>%
  mutate(rep=paste("rep",rep,sep=""))

Sys.time()
```
## experiment date
```{r}
ma_exp_date<-paste(getwd(),"raw_data","experiment_info.xlsx",sep="/") %>%
  read_xlsx(sheet = "MA_experiment_data",range = "A1:D36") %>%
  rename(Carbon=`carbon source`) %>%
  left_join(carbon_source,by="Carbon") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Abb))

```

## growth data
```{r}

my_tmp<-ma_plate_layout %>% select(Well,colony,round,colony_round,lineage,rep)
all_ma_df<-NULL
for(i in 1:nrow(ma_exp_date)){
  my_dir<-paste(getwd(),"raw_data","MA","main_data",ma_exp_date$subfolder[i],sep="/")
  my_cb<-ma_exp_date$Abb[i]
  df_each_cb<-extract_od(my_cb, my_dir)
  all_ma_df<-bind_rows(all_ma_df,df_each_cb)
}
all_ma_df<-all_ma_df %>% 
  mutate(Well=paste(Row,Col,sep="")) %>%
  left_join(my_tmp,by="Well")

# Anc
anc_ma_df<-all_ma_df %>%
  filter(round==0 & lineage %in% c("lineage1","lineage5","lineage9"))
anc_ma_df[anc_ma_df$colony_round=="colony1_1@0",]$colony_round<-"colony1@0"
anc_ma_df[anc_ma_df$colony_round=="colony2_1@0",]$colony_round<-"colony2@0"
anc_ma_df[anc_ma_df$colony_round=="colony3_1@0",]$colony_round<-"colony3@0"
  
# Progeny
progeny_ma_df<-all_ma_df %>%
  filter(round!=0)
Sys.time()
```


## control data
```{r}
allctrl_ma_df<-NULL
for(i in 1:nrow(carbon_source)){
  my_dir<-paste(getwd(),"raw_data","MA","control_data",carbon_source$MA_controllfolder[i],sep="/")
  my_cb<-carbon_source$Abb[i]
  df_each_cb<-extract_od(my_cb, my_dir)
  allctrl_ma_df<-bind_rows(allctrl_ma_df,df_each_cb)
}
allctrl_ma_df<-allctrl_ma_df %>% mutate(Well=paste(Row,Col,sep=""))
ctrl_ma_df<-allctrl_ma_df
my_tmp<-ma_plate_layout %>% filter(grepl(pattern = "colony",x = colony)) %>%
  select(Well,rep,colony_round,colony,round,lineage)
ctrl_ma_df<-ctrl_ma_df %>% left_join(my_tmp,by="Well")


my_exclusion<-ma_plate_layout[ma_plate_layout$round==0 & ma_plate_layout$lineage %nin% c("lineage1","lineage5","lineage9"),]$Well
ctrl_ma_df<-ctrl_ma_df %>% filter(Well %nin% my_exclusion)

ctrl_ma_df[ctrl_ma_df$colony_round=="colony1_1@0",]$colony_round<-"colony1@0"
ctrl_ma_df[ctrl_ma_df$colony_round=="colony2_1@0",]$colony_round<-"colony2@0"
ctrl_ma_df[ctrl_ma_df$colony_round=="colony3_1@0",]$colony_round<-"colony3@0"

Sys.time()
```

# Output
```{r}
# cultures without carbon sources (ECOR)
my_out_dat<-ctrl_ecor_df %>% filter(Abb=="Succ") %>%
  select(strain,rep,time,OD) %>%
  rename(od=OD)
my_out_dir<-paste(getwd(),"Output","rawod_ecor_without_carbon.csv",sep="/")
# write_csv(x = my_out_dat,file = my_out_dir)

# sterile cultures
my_out_dat<-blank_ecor_df %>%
  select(Abb,rep,time,OD) %>%
  rename(carbon=Abb,od=OD)
my_out_dir<-paste(getwd(),"Output","rawod_without_strain.csv",sep="/")
# write_csv(x = my_out_dat,file = my_out_dir)

# cultures without carbon sources (MA)
my_out_dat<-ctrl_ma_df %>% filter(Abb=="Succ") %>%
  select(colony,round,colony_round,lineage,rep,time,OD) %>%
  rename(od=OD)
my_out_dir<-paste(getwd(),"Output","rawod_ma_without_carbon.csv",sep="/")
write_csv(x = my_out_dat,file = my_out_dir)

# ECOR
my_tmp<-ecor_plate_layout %>% select(Well,Strain,Reps) %>%
  filter(Well %in% strain_wells) %>%
  rename(strain=Strain,rep=Reps) %>%
  mutate(rep=paste("rep",rep,sep=""))
my_out_dat<-all_ecor_df %>% filter(Well %in% strain_wells) %>%
  rename(od=OD,carbon=Abb) %>% 
  left_join(my_tmp,by="Well") %>%
  select(strain,rep,carbon,time,od)
my_out_dir<-paste(getwd(),"Output","rawod_ecor_with_carbon.csv",sep="/")
# write_csv(x = my_out_dat,file = my_out_dir)

# MA
## Anc
my_out_dat<-anc_ma_df %>%
  rename(od=OD,carbon=Abb) %>% 
  select(colony,round,colony_round,lineage,rep,carbon,time,od)
my_out_dir<-paste(getwd(),"Output","rawod_ma_anc_with_carbon.csv",sep="/")

## Progeny

  rename(od=OD,carbon=Abb) %>% 
  select(colony,round,colony_round,lineage,rep,carbon,time,od)
my_out_dir<-paste(getwd(),"Output","rawod_ma_progeny_with_carbon.csv",sep="/")

Sys.time()
```
